title: Rename Mage.Client.Headless to Mage.Client.Bridge
description:
The Maven module Mage.Client.Headless should be renamed to Mage.Client.Bridge to match our bridge/pilot/observer naming conventions. The headless client acts as the bridge — it connects to the XMage server, translates game state into MCP tool calls, and relays pilot decisions back. 'Headless' is a legacy name describing what it lacks (no GUI); 'Bridge' describes what it does.

Precondition: before renaming, verify that the observer (Mage.Client.Streaming) does NOT depend on Mage.Client.Headless at runtime or compile time. If both the bridge and observer share this module, 'Bridge' is the wrong name — it would need a name that reflects the shared role (e.g. Mage.Client.Agent or similar), which requires more thought.

If it's bridge-only, renaming involves the directory, Maven artifactId, package names (mage.client.headless -> mage.client.bridge), and updating all references in the Makefile, puppeteer code, CI configs, and CLAUDE.md.
